description: Boruta, the devil of Polish legend disguised as a Polish nobleman: a green kontusz coat with a red sash, a fur cap with a pheasant feather, a curled black moustache, small horns peeking from under the cap, a sly grin, one leg ending in a black goat hoof instead of a boot, holding out a rolled parchment contract and a quill, full body, three-quarter view, isolated figure on a plain background, muted dark colours
